posts.t: Jagger Firkus gets the solo lap to begin warmups ahead of his NHL debut for the Kraken vs. the Hurricanes at the NHL Global Series Finland in Helsinki.

Jagger Firkus to make NHL debut for Kraken in Global Series finale: 

www.nhl.com/news/jagger-...

Kracken coach Lane Lambert confirmed that Jagger Firkus will make his NHL debut today. He said it will be a game time decision who comes out on the lineup in his place. Jani Nyman appeared to be the odd man out yesterday, but Lambert wouldn’t confirm that.

Kraken coach Lane Lambert would not confirm that Jagger Firkus will make his NHL debut tomorrow and Jani Nyman will come out.

He said Ryan Lindgren (upper body) and Jacob Melanson (pseudo aneurysm) are getting really close and will be game time decisions tomorrow.

The #SeaKraken  have recalled forward Jagger Firkus from the Coachella Valley Firebirds.

The team has also placed forward Curtis Douglas on injured reserve retroactive to Oct. 30 (upper body).
